issue: Project file specifies net10.0 instead of net8.0 as shown in spec
response: Intentional deviation. DabblerPdf library targets net10.0, so the samples project must also target net10.0 to reference it via ProjectReference. Using net8.0 would cause a build failure. The spec note says 'Adjust the ProjectReference path to match the actual DabblerPdf project location in the repo' — the TFM must similarly match.
